events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Halifax, Yorkshire, son of Nathan Whitley.

evidence.quote: Whitley was born in Halifax , Yorkshire , on 8 February 1866

events.text: Married Margherita Virginia Marchetti.

evidence.quote: In 1892 , Whitley married Margherita ( Margaret ) Virginia Marchetti

events.text: Became Liberal MP for Halifax.

evidence.quote: Whitley became Liberal Member of Parliament ( MP ) for Halifax in 1900

events.text: Began service as Junior Lord of the Treasury.

evidence.quote: He served as Junior Lord of the Treasury from 1907

events.text: Ended service as Junior Lord of the Treasury.

evidence.quote: Junior Lord of the Treasury from 1907 to 1910

events.text: Appointed Deputy Chairman of Ways and Means.

evidence.quote: He was appointed Deputy Chairman of Ways and Means 1910–1911

events.text: Ended role as Deputy Chairman of Ways and Means.

evidence.quote: He was appointed Deputy Chairman of Ways and Means 1910–1911

events.label: honour
events.text: Made Privy Counsellor.

evidence.quote: Privy Counsellor in 1911

events.text: Became Chairman of Ways and Means and Deputy Speaker of the House of Commons.

evidence.quote: he held the role of Chairman of Ways and Means , Deputy Speaker of the House of Commons , from 1911 to 1921

events.text: Appointed to chair committee on employer-employee relations.

evidence.quote: in 1917 , Whitley was appointed to chair a committee to report on the Relations of Employers and Employees

events.text: Ended role as Chairman of Ways and Means and Deputy Speaker.

evidence.quote: from 1911 to 1921

events.text: Appointed Speaker of the House of Commons.

evidence.quote: Whitley was appointed Speaker of the House of Commons in 1921

events.text: First wife Margherita died.

evidence.quote: Margherita died in 1925

events.text: Resigned as Speaker on grounds of ill health.

evidence.quote: a post he held until 1928 , when he resigned on grounds of ill health

events.text: Resigned as MP for Halifax.

evidence.quote: a seat he held until he resigned in 1928

events.text: Remarried Helen Clarke in Chelsea.

evidence.quote: John Henry remarried in 1928 to Helen Clarke in Chelsea

events.text: Appointed Chairman of the BBC Board of Governors.

evidence.quote: his appointment as Chairman of the Board of Governors of the BBC in 1930

events.text: Royal Commission on Labour in India, which he chaired, reported.

evidence.quote: He chaired the Royal Commission on Labour in India , which reported in 1931

events.text: Made the first broadcast on the Empire Service.

evidence.quote: In 1932 , he made the first broadcast on the Empire Service

events.label: death
events.text: Died, aged 68.

evidence.quote: Whitley died on 3 February 1935

events.text: BBC Chairmanship ended at his death.

evidence.quote: He held the Chairmanship until his death
Whitley died on 3 February 1935
